adaptive_view.option.enabled.tooltip: Master switch. Your own render distance is used as the base value.
adaptive_view.option.min_distance.toolti: Adaptive distance never goes below this (unless your own value is lower).
adaptive_view.option.max_distance.toolti: Adaptive distance never goes above this (unless your own value is higher).
adaptive_view.option.show_overlay.toolti: Shows the current distance and active rules in the top-left corner.
adaptive_view.option.elytra_enabled.tool: More chunks while flying with an elytra.
adaptive_view.option.elytra_bonus.toolti: Chunks added to your render distance while gliding.
adaptive_view.option.forest_enabled.tool: Fewer chunks in forests, jungles, taiga or among dense leaves (lots of geometry).
adaptive_view.option.forest_leaf_percent: Share of nearby sampled blocks that must be leaves to count as dense forest.
adaptive_view.option.mountain_enabled.to: Fewer chunks in mountain and hill biomes.
adaptive_view.option.combat_enabled.tool: Fewer chunks for a while after YOU hit an entity (hits on you do not count).
adaptive_view.option.combat_seconds.tool: How long the reduction lasts after your last hit.
adaptive_view.option.low_fps_enabled.too: Fewer chunks while FPS is under the threshold.
adaptive_view.option.low_fps_threshold.t: Below this FPS the reduction applies.
adaptive_view.option.raise_delay.tooltip: Seconds a better situation must last before the distance goes up.
adaptive_view.option.lower_delay.tooltip: Seconds before the distance goes down.
adaptive_view.option.step_size.tooltip: Chunks changed per step (bigger = faster but more noticeable).
